artifact.name: Z-Girl v3.18 Human-Centered Commercial Foundation RC2

review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio governed production review
review.notes: RC2.4 preserves the high-resolution human-centered support visuals and adds a governed partner-channel surface for referral/affiliate, authorized reseller/implementation, sponsored access, and community fundraising interest. Public Demo security remains inherited from protected production main; partner economics and customer entitlements remain inactive.

ai_uses.purpose: Human-centered experience architecture, monetization-channel design, copy adaptation, visual direction, QA, and governed release preparation
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: AI supports consistent role-specific experience design and scalable distribution architecture while trusted human relationships remain central
ai_uses.human_oversight: Owner retains final public-release and commercial-terms approval; participant sharing remains controlled; human supporters retain real-world authority; partner economics require written activation
ai_uses.provenance: Application implementation and governed visual direction in lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach; candidate photography provenance recorded in governance/visual-rights/human-support-unsplash-v1.json

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: Customer entitlements, commission schedules, reseller economics, fundraising activation, seller/entity authority, visual final acceptance, and public release remain governance decisions rather than automatic actions.

evidence: Role scenes are relationship-specific high-resolution photography rather than sprite crops
Mobile role carousel preserves complete cards with explicit swipe affordance
Partner channels are presented as a clear commercial pathway rather than scattered experimental offers
AI-assisted production and QA enforce the human-first visual, handoff, and distribution architecture without granting AI professional authority
Visuals emphasize trusted relationships and participant control
Sponsored-access and community-funding models explicitly prohibit participant-data exchange for funding
Sprite architecture removed from Human Support surface
Direct browser image rendering avoids prior optimizer failure and destructive sprite enlargement
Partner-channel page reuses the existing rate-limited commerce-lead pipeline
RC remains based on protected main
Each role scene retains descriptive alt text
Mobile horizontal navigation includes a visible swipe cue
Partner-channel content remains text-forward with large touch targets
No character canon is redefined
Human support remains contextual to the existing Hero Within experience
Partner pathways preserve the Z-Girl brand and product governance boundary
Public Demo security controls are inherited from current main
No participant reflection data is added to commercial marketing surfaces
Affiliate commissions, reseller authority, sponsored access, fundraising claims, and entitlements remain unactivated
Partner guardrails explicitly prohibit access to private youth/support data
Candidate photography source provenance is recorded

exceptions: Candidate photography is governed by its recorded source license and remains subject to final campaign-specific rights/model-release review where applicable.

Partner applications may be collected, but affiliate commissions, reseller margins/territories, sponsorship recognition, public fundraising claims, paid checkout activation, institutional customer entitlements, and broader live-data access remain inactive until explicit owner-approved terms and entity authority exist.
Explicit owner approval is required before merge/public commercial release.
